value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor looks hot and a bit stormy early. Early morning could bring some showers and a chance of thunderstorms, then it clears up in the morning. The high is around 29, feeling like about 35 with the humidity, and it gets windy late morning with gusts up to around 60 km/h. Still late-season heat, per the forecast as of this afternoon.
